```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

# One interaction style for every girafe figure: a clear hover pop, dimming
# of non-hovered marks, a dark tooltip, and toolbar zoom + PNG download.
set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)
```

```{r}
#| label: registry
#| include: false
# Key on athlete id, never name: recruiting ids collide (decision 0013), and
# picks has two Josh Allens (Wyoming 2018, Kentucky 2019).
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who            , ~cfb_athlete_id ,
  "Joe Burrow"    , "3915511"       ,
  "Cam Ward"      , "4688380"       ,
  "Josh Allen"    , "3918298"       ,
  "Jordan Travis" , "4360799"       ,
  "Braxton Miller" , "512838"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: load
#| include: false
pp <- dbReadTable(con, "position_path")
picks <- dbReadTable(con, "picks")
stopifnot(nrow(pp) > 0, nrow(picks) > 0, !anyDuplicated(pp$playerId))

# One display name per athlete id, from the draft record (decision 0022 ids
# are unique within this table, so the name is the draftee's).
player_names <- picks |>
  filter(!is.na(playerId)) |>
  distinct(playerId, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  transmute(playerId, player = name)
pp <- left_join(pp, player_names, by = "playerId")

pos_levels <- harmonized_position_levels()
rec_levels <- setdiff(pos_levels, "Position not recorded")

# Every named subject is a row of the table, with the group the post relies on.
named <- pp |> filter(playerId %in% subjects$cfb_athlete_id)
stopifnot(nrow(named) == nrow(subjects))
```

```{r}
#| label: universe-facts
#| include: false
# The population the post reasons about, counted once and reused below.
n_universe <- nrow(pp)
n_hs_linked <- sum(pp$hs_linked)
n_hs_by <- table(factor(pp$hs_link_method, c("name", "name_variant", "school_year")))
n_hs_rec <- sum(pp$hs_linked & !is.na(pp$hs_group) & pp$hs_group != "Position not recorded")
n_college_rec <- sum(pp$college_groups > 0)
n_drafted <- sum(pp$drafted)
n_nfl_linked <- sum(pp$nfl_linked)
n_nfl_rec <- sum(!is.na(pp$nfl_group))
# The roster lists one position per athlete; the caveat relies on it.
n_multi_season <- sum(pp$college_seasons > 1L)
stopifnot(sum(pp$college_changed) == 0L)
stopifnot(
  n_universe == 134903L,
  n_hs_linked == 36578L,
  sum(n_hs_by) == n_hs_linked,
  n_nfl_linked == 3732L
)
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-11-05. Careers of recent
classes are right-censored; later seasons may not yet be present.*
:::

## 1. Introduction

A recruit is listed as a quarterback, a defensive end, or an athlete before he
has played a snap, and the NFL lists him again by a position of its own. This
post asks how often those labels agree, from high school to college and from
college to the draft. The recurring cast gives a concrete test. Joe Burrow, Cam
Ward, and Jordan Travis were all college quarterbacks, and each was drafted as
one.

+ *Expectation one: most high school recruits who played college football kept
  their position group in college.*
+ *Expectation two: nearly every drafted player kept his college position group
  in the NFL.*

## 2. Data

### 2.1 Position groups agree with one another for most players, but the sources cover different players

Each source uses its own vocabulary, so every raw position is first mapped to
one of eleven shared groups. The table counts how many players each stage can
place, since a player with no record at a stage drops out of that stage's
comparison.

```{r}
#| label: terms
tibble::tribble(
  ~Term                   , ~Meaning                                                                                       ,
  "Athlete id"            , "The college player's id in the roster and draft records. One id is one player in this table.",
  "Position group"        , "One of eleven shared groups, such as Quarterback or Defensive line; blanks are 'Position not recorded'.",
  "High school group"     , "The group of the recruit record linked to this athlete by name, or by school and class year (see the next table); recruits without a link have none.",
  "College group"         , "The group recorded on the athlete's roster, across seasons (modal group is the one the most seasons list).",
  "NFL group"             , "The group of the nflverse draft record for the player's draft slot, when that slot is linked to the athlete."
) |>
  kable(caption = "The terms used throughout.")
```

```{r}
#| label: stage-table
tibble::tribble(
  ~Stage                                                  , ~Players                 , ~Share                         ,
  "College athlete ids on a roster"                       , fmt(n_universe)          , "100.0%"                       ,
  "Linked to a high school recruit record"                , fmt(n_hs_linked)         , pct(n_hs_linked / n_universe)  ,
  "Of these, by the same name"                                    , fmt(n_hs_by[["name"]])         , pct(n_hs_by[["name"]] / n_universe)         ,
  "Of these, by a nickname or spelling variant, same school and class year", fmt(n_hs_by[["name_variant"]]), pct(n_hs_by[["name_variant"]] / n_universe),
  "Of these, by school and class year (no college name on file)"  , fmt(n_hs_by[["school_year"]])  , pct(n_hs_by[["school_year"]] / n_universe)  ,
  "High school position recorded"                         , fmt(n_hs_rec)            , pct(n_hs_rec / n_universe)     ,
  "College position recorded in at least one season"      , fmt(n_college_rec)       , pct(n_college_rec / n_universe),
  "Drafted (any CFBD draft pick)"                         , fmt(n_drafted)           , pct(n_drafted / n_universe)    ,
  "Linked to an NFL draft record (draft slot)"            , fmt(n_nfl_linked)        , pct(n_nfl_linked / n_universe) ,
  "NFL position recorded"                                 , fmt(n_nfl_rec)           , pct(n_nfl_rec / n_universe)
) |>
  kable(
    align = "lrr",
    caption = "How many college athletes each stage can place in a position group."
  )
```

## 3. Results

### 3.1 Most high school recruits keep their position group through college

*Expectation: most linked recruits who played college football kept their group.* ✅

The first comparison takes each linked recruit with a recorded high school
position and a recorded college position, and asks whether the two groups match.
The exhibits show the share that stayed, by high school group, and where the
others went.

```{r}
#| label: s31-prep
hs <- pp |>
  filter(
    hs_linked,
    !is.na(hs_group), hs_group != "Position not recorded",
    college_groups > 0, !is.na(college_modal_group)
  )
hs_overall <- mean(hs$hs_group == hs$college_modal_group)
hs_stay <- hs |>
  group_by(hs_group) |>
  summarise(
    recruits = n(),
    stayed = sum(hs_group == college_modal_group),
    share = stayed / recruits,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(share)
stopifnot(
  sum(hs_stay$recruits) == nrow(hs),
  hs_overall > 0.5
)
```

```{r}
#| label: s31-table
hs_stay |>
  transmute(
    `High school group` = hs_group,
    `Recruits linked and recorded` = fmt(recruits),
    `Same group in college` = fmt(stayed),
    `Share who stayed` = pct(share)
  ) |>
  kable(
    align = "lrrr",
    caption = paste0(
      "Linked recruits who played college football, by high school position ",
      "group. Overall, ", pct(hs_overall), " kept the same group."
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: s31-explain
#| fig-height: 6
bars <- hs_stay |>
  mutate(
    hs_group = factor(hs_group, levels = hs_group),
    side = if_else(share >= hs_overall, "at or above", "below")
  )
p <- ggplot(bars, aes(x = share, y = hs_group, fill = side)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %s of %s kept their group (%s)",
        hs_group, fmt(stayed), fmt(recruits), pct(share)
      ),
      data_id = as.character(hs_group)
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = hs_overall, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#111827") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = hs_overall,
    y = nrow(bars) + 0.7,
    label = paste("All linked recruits:", pct(hs_overall)),
    hjust = 0.5,
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("at or above" = "#1d4ed8", "below" = "#9ca3af"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Share of recruits in the group who played the same group in college",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: s31-explore
#| fig-height: 7
hs_grid <- hs |>
  count(hs_group, college_modal_group, name = "n") |>
  tidyr::complete(
    hs_group = rec_levels,
    college_modal_group = rec_levels,
    fill = list(n = 0L)
  ) |>
  group_by(hs_group) |>
  mutate(row_share = n / pmax(sum(n), 1L)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    hs_group = factor(hs_group, levels = rev(rec_levels)),
    college_modal_group = factor(college_modal_group, levels = rec_levels)
  )
p <- ggplot(hs_grid, aes(college_modal_group, hs_group, fill = row_share)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "High school %s, college %s: %s recruits (%s of the %s group)",
        as.character(hs_group), as.character(college_modal_group),
        fmt(n), pct(row_share), as.character(hs_group)
      ),
      data_id = paste(hs_group, college_modal_group)
    ),
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#f9fafb",
    high = "#1d4ed8",
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    name = "Share of high school group"
  ) +
  labs(x = "College position group", y = "High school position group") +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 8)
```

```{r}
#| label: s31-pin
#| include: false
jt <- pp |> filter(playerId == "4360799")
stopifnot(
  jt$hs_group == "Quarterback",
  jt$college_modal_group == "Quarterback",
  jt$nfl_group == "Quarterback"
)
```

Quarterbacks are the clearest case. Jordan Travis was recruited as a
quarterback, played quarterback at Florida State, and was drafted as one in 2024.

### 3.2 Nearly every drafted player keeps his college position group in the NFL

*Expectation: nearly every drafted player kept his college group.* ✅

The second comparison takes each draftee who has a linked NFL draft record and a
recorded college group, and checks the NFL group against the college one. The
table and the bars give the share that matched, and the interactive grid shows
the few moves between groups.

```{r}
#| label: s32-prep
dr <- pp |>
  filter(
    nfl_linked,
    !is.na(nfl_group), nfl_group != "Position not recorded",
    college_groups > 0, !is.na(college_modal_group)
  )
nfl_overall <- mean(dr$nfl_group == dr$college_modal_group)
nfl_stay <- dr |>
  group_by(college_modal_group) |>
  summarise(
    draftees = n(),
    stayed = sum(nfl_group == college_modal_group),
    share = stayed / draftees,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(share)
conv <- dr |>
  filter(college_modal_group == "Quarterback", nfl_group != "Quarterback")
stopifnot(
  sum(nfl_stay$draftees) == nrow(dr),
  nfl_overall > 0.9,
  "512838" %in% conv$playerId
)
```

```{r}
#| label: s32-table
nfl_stay |>
  transmute(
    `College group` = college_modal_group,
    `Draftees linked and recorded` = fmt(draftees),
    `Same group in the NFL` = fmt(stayed),
    `Share who stayed` = pct(share)
  ) |>
  kable(
    align = "lrrr",
    caption = paste0(
      "Linked draftees by college position group. Overall, ",
      pct(nfl_overall), " kept the same group in the NFL."
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: s32-explain
#| fig-height: 6
bars <- nfl_stay |>
  mutate(
    college_modal_group = factor(college_modal_group, levels = college_modal_group),
    side = if_else(share >= nfl_overall, "at or above", "below")
  )
p <- ggplot(bars, aes(x = share, y = college_modal_group, fill = side)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %s of %s kept their group in the NFL (%s)",
        as.character(college_modal_group), fmt(stayed), fmt(draftees), pct(share)
      ),
      data_id = as.character(college_modal_group)
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = nfl_overall, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#111827") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = nfl_overall,
    y = nrow(bars) + 0.7,
    label = paste("All linked draftees:", pct(nfl_overall)),
    hjust = 0.5,
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("at or above" = "#1d4ed8", "below" = "#9ca3af"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Share of draftees in the college group who played the same group in the NFL",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: s32-explore
#| fig-height: 7
nfl_grid <- dr |>
  count(college_modal_group, nfl_group, name = "n") |>
  tidyr::complete(
    college_modal_group = rec_levels,
    nfl_group = rec_levels,
    fill = list(n = 0L)
  ) |>
  group_by(college_modal_group) |>
  mutate(row_share = n / pmax(sum(n), 1L)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    college_modal_group = factor(college_modal_group, levels = rev(rec_levels)),
    nfl_group = factor(nfl_group, levels = rec_levels)
  )
p <- ggplot(nfl_grid, aes(nfl_group, college_modal_group, fill = row_share)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "College %s, NFL %s: %s draftees (%s of the %s group)",
        as.character(college_modal_group), as.character(nfl_group),
        fmt(n), pct(row_share), as.character(college_modal_group)
      ),
      data_id = paste(college_modal_group, nfl_group)
    ),
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#f9fafb",
    high = "#1d4ed8",
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    name = "Share of college group"
  ) +
  labs(x = "NFL position group", y = "College position group") +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 8)
```

```{r}
#| label: s32-pin
#| include: false
pins <- pp |> filter(playerId %in% c("3915511", "4688380", "4360799"))
stopifnot(
  all(pins$college_modal_group == "Quarterback"),
  all(pins$nfl_group == "Quarterback")
)
miller <- pp |> filter(playerId == "512838")
stopifnot(
  miller$hs_group == "Quarterback",
  miller$college_modal_group == "Quarterback",
  miller$nfl_group == "Receiver"
)
# School and draft year come from the draft record, not the position table.
rec_picks <- picks |> filter(playerId %in% c("512838", "4360799", "3915511", "4688380"))
stopifnot(
  rec_picks$collegeTeam[rec_picks$playerId == "512838"] == "Ohio State",
  rec_picks$year[rec_picks$playerId == "4360799"] == 2024L,
  rec_picks$overall[rec_picks$playerId == "3915511"] == 1L,
  rec_picks$overall[rec_picks$playerId == "4688380"] == 1L
)
```

The converted quarterbacks are rare. Braxton Miller was recruited as a
dual-threat player (recorded as a quarterback in the recruit record), played
quarterback at Ohio State, and was drafted as a receiver. Joe Burrow and Cam
Ward played quarterback in college and were drafted as quarterbacks, Burrow
first overall in 2020 and Ward first overall in 2025.

## 4. Summary

Most recruits keep their group, and nearly all draftees keep their college group
into the NFL.

```{r}
#| label: summary
tibble::tribble(
  ~Expectation                                                       , ~Verdict , ~Evidence                                                                 ,
  "Most linked recruits kept their group through college"            , "✅"      , paste0(pct(hs_overall), " of ", fmt(nrow(hs)), " recruits")         ,
  "Nearly every drafted player kept his college group in the NFL"    , "✅"      , paste0(pct(nfl_overall), " of ", fmt(nrow(dr)), " draftees")         ,
) |>
  kable(
    align = "lcl",
    caption = "Each expectation and what the data showed."
  )
```

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
Position is the most stable label in a player's path. The mismatches cluster
where a group is close to another: a recruit listed as an athlete is recorded
as a receiver or a defensive back in college, and a college defensive lineman
is sometimes an NFL linebacker. These are the positions a player is moved into when
his skills fit a neighbouring role, so a recruit's listed group is a usable
starting point for a forecast.
:::

Caveats. The high school comparison covers recruits linked to a college id,
about `r pct(n_hs_linked / n_universe)` of the roster athlete ids. A recruit is
linked when the names agree, or, for a nickname or a player with no college
name on file, when he enrolled at the school he committed to within two years
of his class. Checked against the matching names, that school and class year
rule joins two different people in an estimated 0.6% of links. The NFL comparison covers only
draftees linked by draft slot, and the undrafted players in the NFL data have no
bridge to a college id, so they are not in it. The college roster records one
position per athlete (none of the `r fmt(n_multi_season)` players with more
than one recorded season changes group), so position changes within college
cannot be observed in this source. Recent classes are right-censored, and the recruit positions are the
recruiting service's listings, not the player's own account.
